# Fixture for PERF-PY-27 (safe): once-per-distinct-path load in a loop
lang: python
file: app/summarize_runs.py
---
from pathlib import Path

def summarize(unique_paths):
    runs = []
    for path in unique_paths:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        runs.append(text)
    return runs
